workPackageTitle: Orthographic camera, world conversion, clamp, footprint publication
notes: Entries are added before implementation and are never renumbered (docs/technical/91-verification-strategy.md § Verification registry). This file was created in the same commit that first implements against it, and every entry below was authored before the production code it names.

'status' takes exactly one of 'registered', 'implemented', 'retired' (doc 91 § Entry status). 'evidenceKinds' is read against 'status' (doc 91 § What evidenceKinds means): for a 'registered' entry the list is evidence the verification will produce once built, and nothing may treat it as produced.

The structural validator for this file is owned by TASK-FND-009-002. Until it lands, this file is checked against tests/verification/SIM-007.json by hand, and the claim is about SHAPE only: every entry here carries the same field names with the same types - 'status' a bare string, 'scenarios', 'evidenceKinds', and 'fixtures' arrays - and the optional 'deferredTo' is absent. An earlier revision of this file rotated four of those fields against each other, so 'status' held a scenario ID in an array and 'evidenceKinds' held an artifact path, which doc 91:63 names as its own example of a value that is not a kind. It is corrected above. The kind vocabulary is now matched, by reuse rather than by minting: the revision before this one reached for 'engine-report', 'canonical-transcript', and 'reference-capture', none of which was in doc 91 § What a kind may name's inventory, which doc 91:78 forbids. All three are replaced above by kinds already in that inventory, because no one of them named a form of evidence the inventory lacked - 'engine-log' for the harness transcript's text, 'test-counts' for the assertion totals that transcript carries, and 'captured-artifact' for the rendered frame set, which is claimed by PRE-002 alone. This file owes doc 91 nothing further.

This file is deliberately NOT named SIM-0*.json. tests/MechaMiner.Simulation.Tests/Support/NegativeControlCoverageTests.cs globs 'SIM-0*.json' and asserts a totals line accounting for every entry across those seven files, so adding an entry to one of them from another work package would break an unrelated package's gate.

See PRE-001.json's notes for why every entry here is 'registered': no test project may reference MechaMiner.Game under the accepted project boundary, so presentation verification is an engine-tier scene procedure.

The 24-metre vertical extent is retained rather than chosen. doc 30 § Camera: 'Agents retain this value through M4 without preference review', and adopting perspective 'requires a superseding gameplay and technical decision'. An entry that asserted a tuned value would misrepresent it, so VER-PRE-002-001 asserts the retained one.

Boundary clamping and the published rendered/next-tick ground footprint are the rest of PRE-002's payload and have no entry here yet. Clamping needs a finite authored boundary, and footprint publication exists to validate offscreen spawning, which is GEO-007 and ENC work this slice does not reach.

entries.summary: The gameplay camera is orthographic, north-up, and non-rotating, and shows exactly 24 gameplay metres vertically, so a body at the vertical edge of the viewport is 12 metres from the camera's ground centre.
